triggers.name: new_survey_response

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own SurveyMonkey action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your SurveyMonkey connection OAuth scopes: Scopes survey:read, collectors:read, collectors:write, contacts:read, respons:read, response details:read, webhook:read, webhook:write, user:read

input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb

actions.name: add_contacts
actions.title: Add contacts
actions.description: Add contacts to a SurveyMonkey contact list
actions.help: Adds one or more contacts to an existing contact list. Each contact requires an email. Partial successes are reported per contact.

input.name: contact_list_id
input.label: Contact list ID
input.hint: ID of the contact list to add contacts to.

input.name: contacts
input.label: Contacts
input.hint: Each contact must include an email, and may include first_name and last_name.

actions.name: add_page

input.label: Survey ID
input.hint: ID of the survey to add the page to.

input.name: position
input.label: Position
input.hint: 1-based position for the page. Appended at the end if omitted.

actions.name: create_contact_list

actions.name: create_survey
actions.title: Create survey
actions.help: Creates a survey blank, from a SurveyMonkey template, or by copying an existing survey. Provide at most one source — not both a template ID and a survey ID.

input.hint: Title of the new survey.

input.label: Template ID
input.hint: ID of a SurveyMonkey library template to base the survey on (from List survey templates ). Do not combine with Survey ID to copy.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.title: Create webhook
actions.help: Subscribes to survey, collector, or app lifecycle events. The subscription URL must accept a HEAD request and return 200. Object type is required for all event types except survey_created . When object type is set, object IDs must also be provided. Do not set object type to collector for collector_c…

input.name: name
input.label: Webhook name
input.hint: A label for the webhook subscription.

input.name: subscription_url
input.label: Subscription URL
input.hint: HTTPS endpoint SurveyMonkey will POST event payloads to. Must accept a HEAD request and return 200.

input.name: event_type
input.label: Event type
input.hint: Event to subscribe to.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object type
input.hint: Required for all event types except survey_created . When set, Object IDs must also be provided.

input.name: object_ids
input.label: Object IDs
input.hint: IDs of the surveys, collectors, or apps to watch. Required when Object type is set.

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.title: Delete webhook
actions.help: Deletes a single webhook subscription and stops its event delivery. Use List webhooks and Get webhook to identify the exact webhook before deleting. Deletes the subscription only — no survey or response data is affected.

input.label: Webhook ID
input.hint: ID of the webhook to delete. Identify it via List webhooks and Get webhook first.

input.name: survey_id
input.label: Survey ID
input.hint: ID of the survey the response belongs to.

input.name: response_id
input.label: Response ID
input.hint: ID of the response to retrieve. Obtain from List responses .
